meeting_scene: As the team gathered around the conference table, the air was filled with an air of calm, with Alex speaking first, their voice barely above a whisper, "I wanted to touch base on the new project, I've been thinking a lot about how we can optimize our workflow to meet the deadline." The team nodded in agreement, with Jordan leaning forward, his eyes locked onto Alex's, "I've been thinking the same thing, we need to make sure we're staying ahead of the curve." Meanwhile, Sam fidgeted with his pen, his stress level still evident, but his morale remained high, a testament to his dedication to the team. As the discussion progressed, Priya and Riya chimed in with suggestions, their calm and collected demeanor a soothing presence in the room, while Vikram's stress level remained steady, a hint of a smile playing on his lips.
